stories.title: Trezor Confirms ShipMonk Data Breach Exposed 67,000 Additional US Customers
stories.description: Hardware wallet maker Trezor has confirmed that a data breach at logistics partner ShipMonk is substantially larger than first reported, after older U.S. order records that should have been deleted remained in the leaked dataset.

stories.title: Google Patches 6th Chrome Zero-Day of 2026
stories.description: Google’s Chrome 152 security update resolves 12 vulnerabilities, including a high-severity type confusion flaw in the V8 engine.

stories.title: Microsoft Teams to Add QR Code Protection in Teams Messaging
stories.description: Microsoft Teams is preparing to introduce new QR code protection controls designed to reduce phishing and fraud risks in chats involving external users.

stories.title: Over 440,000 Exploit Attempts Target Super Forms and Elementor Pro RCE Flaws
stories.description: Attackers are exploiting Super Forms and Elementor Pro flaws to upload PHP files and execute code on WordPress sites.

stories.title: 14 Fake macOS Installers Linked to DPRK Campaign Deliver Credential-Stealing RAT
stories.description: Fake macOS installers are spreading a credential-stealing RAT, targeting developers and job seekers through the Contagious Interview campaign.

stories.title: Plex Urges Immediate Updates After Patching Multiple Undisclosed Security Flaws
stories.description: Plex fixes multiple undisclosed flaws in Media Server 1.43.3 and Desktop 1.115.0, urging users to update.

stories.title: Dahua Camera Backdoor Survives Password Changes and Factory Resets on Compromised Devices
stories.description: Over 14,000 Dahua cameras were compromised worldwide using weak credentials and flaws, exposing video feeds and device settings.

stories.title: Google Releases Chrome Update to Patch Actively Exploited V8 Zero-Day
stories.description: Google patched an actively exploited Chrome V8 flaw that enables arbitrary code execution inside the sandbox through a crafted HTML page.

stories.title: GPT-6 Astra Scores 100% on ExploitBench as OpenAI Blocks PoC Exploit Requests
stories.description: OpenAI limits GPT-6 Astra to code review and patching after tests showed exploit development capabilities, including two zero-days.

stories.title: Manchester Airports Group Data on 8.8 Million People Leaked After Ransom Refusal
stories.description: Hacker group published roughly 550GB of data after MAG reportedly refused to pay a ransom demand; the group says it gained access via exposed admin keys.

stories.title: Capsule Security Launches ‘AI Circuit Breaker’ to Stop Rogue Agents
stories.description: New models, trained using NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra, aim to catch rogue agent behavior before it executes, without the latency of large-model review.

stories.title: HiddenLayer Raises $100 Million for AI Runtime Security
stories.description: The Austin-based company will invest in agentic runtime security capabilities to secure AI coding agents.

stories.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 400 Security Holes
stories.description: Microsoft today released updates to remedy at least 398 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software, including one weakness that is already being actively exploited and two others that were publicly detailed prior to today.
